minor: 'Boeing's chief executive was an engineer who had helped lead the 777 programme' sits in the 1995 section. Condit became CEO in 1996, and the CEO in 1995 was Frank Shrontz. Say 'By 1996 Boeing's chief executive, Philip Condit, was an engineer...' so the date is not implied to be 1995.
'Boeing blamed production problems, not the merger': the source only says production problems. 'Not the merger' is the script's own addition. Cut it, or state that Boeing did not cite the merger.

'nothing new was ready to answer the A320neo' and 'the 787 had absorbed Boeing's engineers and cash' are the script's interpretation. The listed sources give only the 787 delays and the American order. Present them as the film's reading or add a source.

The 'clowns... monkeys' messages date from 2016-17, before the crashes, but they sit after the 'MCAS left out of the manual' beat. Introduce them as 'years before the first crash' so the order is not read as cause.
The FAA directive of 7 Nov 2018 went to MAX operators, who relayed it to crews. 'To crews' is a looser wording.

In the 2025 line, 'moved to drop the charge' is accurate to the source, but the court's later ruling on that motion is not covered. Check whether a ruling has since come and update the line (today is Nov 2026).

The $2.5 billion in January 2021 was a mix of a criminal penalty, compensation to airline customers and the $500 million victims' fund. 'Of that, $500 million' is correct but leaves out the other parts.
